# Luminance's Trust Centre

Luminance maintains an Information Security Program to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of all computer and data communication systems while meeting the necessary legislative, industry, and contractual requirements.

Our Trust Centre offers customers access to Luminance's latest security reports and documents, including ISO certifications and our SOC 2 report.

All FAQs

How is Luminance hosted?

Luminance is hosted securely in AWS, with customer environments logically isolated and dedicated data stores providing separation between organisations. Customers can choose from supported hosting regions to meet geographic and jurisdictional requirements.

https://trust.luminance.com/faq?s=f1fiuz77gjjwi2b2g6afbj

How is customer data encrypted?

All data at rest is encrypted using AES-256. All data in transit is protected using TLS 1.2 or higher with strong, industry-standard cipher suites.

https://trust.luminance.com/faq?s=sfn4ntubuwbfda4fjsm7kl

Where are your servers located?

Customers may choose which AWS Region their data is hosted in.

https://trust.luminance.com/faq?s=n1o00hfuxwdzlgd63fiiv

Do you conduct external penetration testing?

Yes. We commission third-party penetration tests at least annually by a CREST-accredited third-party penetration testing company.

https://trust.luminance.com/faq?s=0pn6913kpgutkh5oytqgnz

Who can access data within Luminance?

Luminance employees, whether on Account Management or Support, cannot view documents unless access is explicitly granted through the platform, and all access is logged and audited. You can control access through configurable application permissions.

https://trust.luminance.com/faq?s=8jxm6sbcj66cwg9zm1my6s

Do you support Single Sign-On?

Yes, we support SSO via any SAML 2.0 compliant identity provider or OIDC with Entra ID. We also support JIT account auto-provisioning and SAML claims mapping.

https://trust.luminance.com/faq?s=ecv2ud8xd7mid7mbd6fdt

Is customer data used to train shared AI?

No, customer data is never used to train shared AI models.

https://trust.luminance.com/faq?s=tnz95pzf2b5wwhxhzi7el
